name: ruindiver-level-forge
description: Deterministically generate, inspect, validate, and edit playable RuinDiver dungeons through Level Forge.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and edit valid RuinDiver dungeons
interface.longDescription: Controls the local RuinDiver Level Forge through its revision-safe JSON-RPC API, validates generated dungeons, and leaves the result open and fully editable.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ruindiver-level-forge to build a fully playable dungeon from my prompt.
